feed_summary: Overview On October 12, 2026, GitLab released 19.4.2 , 19.3.5 , and 19.2.8 to fix CVE-2026-97229 , an integer overflow in its CI/CD regular-expression handling. The issue was reported through HackerOne by joaxcar . GitLab assigned it a CVSS score of 10.0 and described possible code execution by an unauthenticated user. The advisory states that CVE-2026-97229 affects GitLab CE and EE from 19.2 before 19.2.8 , 19.3 before 19.3.5 , and 19.4 before 19.4.2 . GitLab says all deployment types are affected unless stated otherwise. GitLab.com was patched before disclosure, and Dedicated customers do not need to act. Rapid7 researchers developed an end-to-end PoC that reliably runs arbitrary commands as GitLab's git operating-system account on the official Linux amd64 gitlab/gitlab-ce:19.4.1-ce.0 im
title: Rapid7 Analysis: GitLab CI/CD Regex Integer Overflow (CVE-2026-97229)
